how_verified: Every quote was read in its source and copied character for character: the N1C Data S1 PDF (Europe PMC API copy in .cache/n1c/supp/), the Wu 2010 PubMed abstract (E-utilities), and the GeneReviews NBK1295 section from the local archive. Step 1 facts were read from the step 1 outputs, which step 1 acceptance covers.

what.zh: DMD 外显子 52-63 框内缺失 / 外显子跳跃：不适用（阅读框已保留，没有可恢复的框）
what.en: DMD in-frame deletion of exons 52-63 / exon skipping: not applicable (the frame is already kept)

source.doc: Step 1 output out/step1/PRAC-DMD-del.json, retranslation.same_frame_after_change = true (deterministic re-translation, verified in step 1 acceptance)

what.zh: DMD / 基因替代：不适用（CDS 11,055 nt，超出 AAV 约 4.7 kb 容量）
what.en: DMD / gene replacement: not applicable (CDS 11,055 nt, beyond the roughly 4.7 kb AAV capacity)

source.doc: Wu Z, Yang H, Colosi P. Effect of genome size on AAV vector packaging. Mol Ther 2010 (PMID 19904234), abstract
source.quote: packaged AAV vector genomes never exceeded 5.2 kb in length

what.zh: KMT2B c.8079delC（第 37/37 外显子）/ 外显子跳跃：不符合（最后一个编码外显子，跳过会丢失终止密码子）
what.en: KMT2B c.8079delC (exon 37 of 37) / exon skipping: not eligible (last coding exon; skipping it removes the stop codon)

source.doc: N1C VARIANT guidelines, Data S1, Section A (Cheerie D et al., Am J Hum Genet 2025, PMID 40139194, PMC12120168, CC BY); supplementary file obtained 2026-11-05 via the Europe PMC API, kept in .cache/n1c/supp/
source.quote: The first and last coding exons are usually not eligible for exon skipping as this would lead to the loss of the start or stop codon.

what.zh: AGXT c.33dup（第 1/11 外显子）/ 外显子跳跃：不符合（第一个编码外显子，跳过会丢失起始密码子），并写出 N1C 的例外
what.en: AGXT c.33dup (exon 1 of 11) / exon skipping: not eligible (first coding exon; skipping it removes the start codon), with the N1C exception named

source.doc: N1C VARIANT guidelines, Data S1, Section A (Cheerie D et al., Am J Hum Genet 2025, PMID 40139194, PMC12120168, CC BY); supplementary file obtained 2026-11-05 via the Europe PMC API, kept in .cache/n1c/supp/
source.quote: It is theoretically possible to skip the first coding exon if a nearby in-frame start codon exists

what.zh: AGXT c.33dup / 编辑：重复（插入）型，碱基编辑器做不到，只有先导编辑理论上可行；PAM 未评估
what.en: AGXT c.33dup / editing: a duplication (insertion), which base editors cannot make; only prime editing could revert it; PAM not assessed

source.doc: Step 1 output out/step1/PRAC-AGXT-c33dup.json, variant_cdna c.33dup; the editor follows from the change type alone (contract 3.6)

what.zh: COL1A1 c.1678G>A / 编辑：G>A 是转换型，理论上可由腺嘌呤碱基编辑器回复；PAM 未评估
what.en: COL1A1 c.1678G>A / editing: G>A is a transition, revertible in principle by an adenine base editor; PAM not assessed

expect.failed_criterion: adding a normal copy does not

what.zh: COL1A1 p.Gly560Ser（三螺旋区甘氨酸替换）/ 基因替代：不适用——机制不是产物不足，补一份正常拷贝不能消除异常蛋白的作用；机制须引用 GeneReviews 原文
what.en: COL1A1 p.Gly560Ser (glycine substitution in the triple helix) / gene replacement: not applicable - the mechanism is not a shortage of product, so a normal copy does not remove the abnormal protein's effect; the GeneReviews quote is required

source.doc: GeneReviews NBK1295 (COL1A1- and COL1A2-Related Osteogenesis Imperfecta), section Molecular Genetics / Molecular Pathogenesis, local archive; read verbatim 2026-11-06. The chapter uses both words for the same thing - qualitative changes - so either is accepted: the heading says 'gain of function', the body says 'dominant-negative effect'. Both lead to the same verdict here.
source.quote: Perinatally lethal OI, progressively deforming OI, and common variable OI (qualitative, gain of function): Substitutions for glycine within the triple-helical domain of the pro-α chain delay triple helix formation
source.quote_2: Quantitative changes, which lead to loss of function, tend to have a milder phenotype when compared to qualitative changes, which impart a dominant-negative effect.

items.added: 2026-11-05 added; 2026-11-06 widened after reading the chapter again: the source names the mechanism of a glycine substitution both ways, so the expectation accepts either word and pins the conclusion instead.

what.zh: COL1A1 第 25/51 外显子 / 外显子跳跃：可计算的条件（内部外显子、框内、占蛋白 2.3%）都满足，但结构域与天然跳跃证据未查 → 无法评估（上限 likely eligible）
what.en: COL1A1 exon 25 of 51 / exon skipping: the computable criteria are met (internal exon, in frame, 2.3% of the protein), but functional domains and natural-skipping evidence are not checked -> unable to assess (ceiling likely eligible)

source.doc: N1C VARIANT guidelines, Data S1, Section A (Cheerie D et al., Am J Hum Genet 2025, PMID 40139194, PMC12120168, CC BY); supplementary file obtained 2026-11-05 via the Europe PMC API, kept in .cache/n1c/supp/; the two unchecked criteria are the deferred data sources recorded in the contract (decision 2026-11-05)
source.quote: skipping an exon that encodes for more than 10% of the protein is considered “unlikely eligible”, and obtaining functional evidence is the expected next step
